name: Gonzalo Loza Rojas
headline: General Manager @ Voodoo | HEC Paris | TUM | CDTM
summary:
Hi! I'm Gonzalo (they/them), a tech-savvy, startup-enthusiast, double-degree-earning master's candidate from HEC Paris and TU-Munich. I've got a track record of leading Product Development teams, launching new products and services, and revamping user experiences - all while keeping my cool under pressure.

My work experience and studies has made me a person that lives and breathes for innovation with purpose - the crazier, the better. I'm always on the lookout for new opportunities to learn and grow in this fast-paced and ever-changing industry. I'm open to any role, whether it's in a Product Team or as a Founder's Associate/Chief of Staff or a challenging new experience you could propose.

Also, if you're a founder with a wild startup idea and you're looking for someone to join your ride, hit me up - I'm always open to a good chat :) .

positions.title: Head of Product
positions.description:
Travel Related American Startup (B2C) that offers a platform enabling travellers to navigate through the bureaucracy to get to their destination easily.
